Form description

Dear Participant,

I am a second-year Software Engineering student conducting research on the Design and Implementation of an Intelligent House System Based on Light Intensity Control and Security Monitoring.

The purpose of this survey is to understand the security concerns, energy consumption habits, and interest in smart home technologies among residents of Cameroon.

Your responses are anonymous and will be used strictly for academic purposes.

Thank you for your participation.

Étude sur la conception et la mise en œuvre d'un système de maison intelligente basé sur le contrôle de l'intensité lumineuse et la surveillance de la sécurité

Dear Participant,

I am a second-year Software Engineering student conducting research on the Design and Implementation of an Intelligent House System Based on Light Intensity Control and Security Monitoring.

The purpose of this survey is to understand the security concerns, energy consumption habits, and interest in smart home technologies among residents of Cameroon.

Your responses are anonymous and will be used strictly for academic purposes.

Thank you for your participation.
